# WeDeepen

> WeDeepen is a curated ecosystem for extraordinary love, founded by Christina Weber. It brings together relationship experts, immersive in-person experiences, and a membership community for people who want to build and sustain remarkable relationships. Based in Austin, Texas, with experiences run nationally.

WeDeepen's work spans four areas: the WeDeepen Membership ($99/month, live every Tuesday at 7pm ET), multi-day Love Immersion retreats, one-on-one work with vetted relationship experts (called Love Strategists), and a long-running podcast on love, sex, dating, and human connection.

Christina Weber is a Love Industry Pioneer whose work began with Underground Unattached in New York City and continues through WeDeepen in Austin.

## Core pages

- [Home / WeDeepen Membership](https://wedeepen.com/): The $99/month membership: live sessions every Tuesday at 7pm ET with expert faculty, a private community, and a Sunday Dare each week
- [About](https://wedeepen.com/about/): The story of WeDeepen and founder Christina Weber
- [Love Immersion](https://wedeepen.com/love-immersion/): Multi-day immersive relationship retreats, with upcoming dates
- [Love Club](https://wedeepen.com/love-club/): WeDeepen's inner circle, $9,997 a year. Separate from the $99/month Membership, and includes everything in it
- [Love Strategists](https://wedeepen.com/love-guides/): The vetted relationship experts, coaches, and practitioners WeDeepen works with
- [Events](https://wedeepen.com/events/): Upcoming in-person gatherings
- [Reviews](https://wedeepen.com/reviews/): First-hand accounts from participants
- [Photo Gallery](https://wedeepen.com/gallery/): Photography from past events and immersions

## Learn

- [Blog](https://wedeepen.com/blog/): Articles on communication, conflict, trust, emotional intimacy, and dating
- [The Four Pillars](https://wedeepen.com/four-pillars/): WeDeepen's framework for a conscious relationship

## Podcast

The show is now called Mastering Love, formerly Deepen with Christina, hosted by Christina Weber. Long-form conversations with relationship experts, somatic practitioners, authors, and researchers on love, sex, dating, intimacy, and modern relationships.

- [Podcast home](https://wedeepen.com/podcast/): Search and browse episodes
- [Full episode archive](https://wedeepen.com/podcast/archive/): Every episode, listed by year
- Individual episodes live at https://wedeepen.com/deepen-with-christina/[episode-slug]/

## Notes for machine readers

- Every indexable page is listed in [the sitemap](https://wedeepen.com/sitemap.xml)
- The full text of the core pages, blog posts, and episode summaries is in [llms-full.txt](https://wedeepen.com/llms-full.txt)
- Pages carry schema.org structured data: Organization, Event, PodcastEpisode, PodcastSeries, ImageGallery, and Person
- Retreat dates and pricing change; treat the linked pages as the source of truth rather than any cached summary
- [Terms of Use](https://wedeepen.com/terms/) and [Privacy Policy](https://wedeepen.com/privacy/)
